purpose: Frozen Balanced Head parameter decomposition only; no training, tuning, candidate creation, checkpoint modification, or incumbent change.

featureMean.rows: All rows in each admitted training partition.
featureMean.sourceBalance: mu = 0.5 * mean(Hippocorpus features) + 0.5 * mean(Unexpected Events features).

decomposition.direction: v = w_B - alpha*w_I, with dot(v,w_I)=0 up to floating-point error.
decomposition.interpretation: Scale-only receives the complete training-mean logit shift, including bias and the mean carried by v. Direction-only is centered to have zero change at mu.

selector.ranking: Descending score, then canonical input order for exact ties.

references: RTN model-consensus short-Event research diagnostic resolved subset
referenceAnalysis.support: At least 5 reference-positive and 5 reference-negative rows per Product-18 label; sparse labels remain displayed but are excluded from Macro-AP.
referenceAnalysis.averagePrecision: Mean precision at positive ranks after stable descending-logit order; original row order breaks exact score ties.

bootstrap.unit: sourceGroupId/sourceGroup when present, otherwise singleton row
bootstrap.interval: Paired percentile 2.5% to 97.5% for condition-minus-incumbent Micro-F1, supported-label Macro-AP, TP, and FP.

interpretationGate.supported: On both references, direction-only has positive Micro-F1 and supported-label Macro-AP point deltas, preserves at least 50% of full Balanced Micro-F1 and TP gains, cuts at least 50% of full Balanced FP inflation, and at least one of its Micro-F1 or Macro-AP paired intervals has lower bound above zero per reference.
interpretationGate.notSupported: On both references, scale-only preserves at least 80% of full Balanced Micro-F1 and TP gains while direction-only preserves less than 25% of either full gain and has non-positive supported-label Macro-AP delta.
interpretationGate.otherwise: INCONCLUSIVE, including reference disagreement or intervals too wide to satisfy the support rule.
